**DK28.2** is a medical diagnosis code that designates an acute gastrointestinal ulcer with bleeding and perforation ("akut gastrointestinalt sår med blødning og perforation"). In the context of the Danish healthcare system, this code is a critical component for tracking adverse events in patients diagnosed with [[atrieflimren]] (atrial fibrillation).

The primary significance of DK28.2 lies in its use within the national clinical quality indicators for atrial fibrillation, specifically for measuring the incidence of [[alvorlig-bloedning|Alvorlig blødning]] (severe bleeding) [^src1], [^src3]. According to methodology reports from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK) published in 2023, 2024, and 2025, tracking severe bleeding requires a broad and precise set of ICD-10-DK diagnostic codes [^src1], [^src2], [^src3]. DK28.2 is categorized under gastrointestinal bleeding, which is monitored alongside intracranial bleeding, other gastrointestinal codes, and urinary or respiratory bleeding codes [^src1]. 

By explicitly defining DK28.2 and its associated code sets, organizations like the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) and Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut ensure standardized data collection. This allows for rigorous, comparable monitoring of treatment safety and complication rates for cardiovascular patients across all Danish regions [^src2], [^src3].

## Claims
- For incidens af alvorlig blødning anvendes en bred vifte af diagnoser, herunder DI60–DS066 for intrakraniel blødning, DK25.0–DK29.8A og DK92.0–DK92.2 for gastrointestinal blødning samt DJ942, DN02, DR04 og DR31 for urinvejs-/lunge blødning [^src1] (di60, di61, di62, ds064, ds065, ds066, dk25-0, dk25-2, dk25-4, dk25-6, dk26-0, dk26-2, dk26-4, dk26-6, dk27-0, dk27-2, dk27-4, dk27-6, dk28-0, dk28-2, dk28-4, dk28-6, dk29-0, dk29-8a, dk92-0, dk92-1, dk92-2, dj942, dn02, dr04, dr31)
